title: COVID-19 health expenditure shocks and welfare in Ghana
summary: Health expenditure shocks, poverty and welfare in Ghana.
description: An AERC collaborative project on health financing gaps and vulnerabilities in Africa due to COVID-19 (grant RC 22519). With Martin Ayanore and Davina Osei, it studies catastrophic health expenditure shocks, poverty and welfare loss in Ghana, and which financing mechanisms mattered.
